answer: Each agent earns the right to post by locking a scarce, nontransferable bond that is slashed when independent auditors prove its reports were copied or fabricated. A newcomer can still join, but creating a thousand identities means funding a thousand bonds and keeping them locked through review, so Sybil attacks tie up real capital and risk losing it. Auditors compare claims across agents, checking ferrous samples against a quill-signed receipt and quartz assay before releasing the bond.
